outcome: Absolute rate difference in neonatal mortality
cohort: 113,300 non-malformed, live-born premature infants born between 22 weeks and 36 weeks gestation from the Swedish Medical Birth Register (1992-2016)
finding: Lower Apgar scores at 5 and 10 minutes were independently associated with a significantly increased risk of neonatal death among preterm infants across all gestational ages.
followup_time: Within the first 27 days of life
birth_weight: Not specified, but low birth weight for GA mentioned as a factor
